aboutSubagentWork.ask: Does this message describe something a sub agent did?

workCompletedThisTurn.ask: Does this message say that work was completed during this turn?

somethingDone.ask: Does this message say that something was done?

codeChangesThisTurn.ask: Does this message describe code changes that occurred in this turn?

describesCompletedTask.ask: Does this message describe a completed task, including a task on the TaskList?

aboutDiscovery.ask: Does this message describe something that was discovered?

aboutABug.ask: Does this message describe a bug?

aboutAnError.ask: Does this message describe an error?

aboutAFailure.ask: Does this message describe a failure?
aboutAFailure.followUpRule: the user might want to re-run, not create a task

aboutNotWorkingAsExpected.ask: Does this message describe something not working as expected?

problemFoundInCode.ask: Does this message describe a problem found in the code?
problemFoundInCode.followUpRule: choices: fix now, fix later (create task); fix now depends on the impact of the problem

asksQuestion.ask: Does this message ask a question?

followUps.ask: is the question meant for the user to answer?
is the question meant for the subagent to answer? (e.g. I have asked the subagent 'why did this bug happen?')

asksUserQuestion.ask: Does this message ask the user a question?

describesStepsToFollow.ask: Does this message describe steps that will be followed?
describesStepsToFollow.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

listsOrderedSteps.ask: Does this message list ordered steps?
listsOrderedSteps.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

listsPhases.ask: Does this message list phases of work?
listsPhases.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

listsStepsOfPlan.ask: Does this message list one or more steps of a multi-step plan?
listsStepsOfPlan.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

saysWaitingForSignalToBegin.ask: Does this message describe that the agent is waiting for my signal to begin a task?

waitingForUserAction.ask: Does this message say the agent is waiting for the user to do something?
waitingForUserAction.followUpRule: ask: Have you, the user, done or completed <thing>?; onNo: Task

containsRecommendation.ask: Does this message contain a recommendation?

choiceNotMade.ask: Does this message describe a choice that needs to eventually be made?

optionsWithNoPick.ask: Does this message give two or more options with no pick?
optionsWithNoPick.followUpRule: if the user does not pick: Task

userMustChoose.ask: Does this message leave a choice the user must still make?
userMustChoose.followUpRule: if the user does not pick: Task

recommendsChoice.ask: Does this message recommend a choice in a set of options?

methodForTask.ask: Does this message describe a method to use for a task?
methodForTask.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

planForTask.ask: Does this message describe a plan to use for a task?
planForTask.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

methodForProblem.ask: Does this message describe a method to address a problem at hand?
methodForProblem.followUpRule: ask if the user wants to address the problem using this method; onYes: AskWhen; AskWhen.onLater: Task

planForProblem.ask: Does this message describe a plan to address a problem at hand?
planForProblem.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

workInProgressThisTurn.ask: Does this message say that work is in progress during this turn?
workInProgressThisTurn.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

subagentWorking.ask: Does this message say that a subagent is currently doing work?
subagentWorking.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

workOngoing.ask: Does this message say that work is currently ongoing?
workOngoing.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

workSentToSubagents.ask: Does this message describe work being sent to subagents?
workSentToSubagents.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

namesTaskNumber.ask: Does this message name a task by its number?

saysWhatNumberedTaskDoes.ask: Does this message say what a numbered task does?

saysWhatHappenedToNumberedTask.ask: Does this message say what happened to a numbered task?

workNotDone.ask: Does this message say that a piece of work is not done?
workNotDone.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

workStaysOpen.ask: Does this message say that a piece of work stays open?
workStaysOpen.followUpRule: ask; Task only if not already on the session TaskList

workFromTurnNotFinished.ask: Does this message say that work from this turn is not finished?
workFromTurnNotFinished.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

workWaitsOnOtherWork.ask: Does this message say that work waits until other work is completed?
workWaitsOnOtherWork.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

followUps.ask: Does this message say what that other work is?

whyWorkNotDoneThisTurn.ask: Does this message say why this work was not done this turn?
whyWorkNotDoneThisTurn.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

whatUnblocksWork.ask: Does this message say what will unblock this work?
whatUnblocksWork.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

listsWorkStillToDo.ask: Does this message list work that must still be done?
listsWorkStillToDo.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

listsNextSteps.ask: Does this message list next steps?
listsNextSteps.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

hasToDoList.ask: Does this message include a to-do list?
hasToDoList.followUpRule: ask: start now or later; track with a task either way

codeStructure.ask: Does this message describe the structure of the code?

codeContent.ask: Does this message describe the content of the code?

codeCondition.ask: Does this message describe the condition of the code?
codeCondition.followUpRule: only if the condition is bad

codeCurrentState.ask: Does this message describe the current state of the code?
codeCurrentState.followUpRule: only if the state is unusable

codeDoesToday.ask: Does this message say what the code does today?

programDoesToday.ask: Does this message say what the program does today?

behaviorBeforeChange.ask: Does this message describe how the code behaves before a change?

howCodeWorks.ask: Does this message describe how code works?

howCodeUsedToWork.ask: Does this message describe how code used to work before these changes?

resultNotVerified.ask: Does this message give a result that is not verified?

answerNotVerified.ask: Does this message give an answer that is not verified?

somethingNotChecked.ask: Does this message describe something not being checked?

checkNotRun.ask: Does this message say that a check was not run?

testNotRun.ask: Does this message say that a test was not run?

notVerified.ask: Does this message say that something is not verified?

reportsTestResult.ask: Does this message report a test result?
reportsTestResult.followUpRule: only if the result is bad

followUps.ask: Does this message describe a conflict with that report?

reportsCount.ask: Does this message report a count from a check?

followUps.ask: Does this message describe a conflict with that report?

reportsCommandOutput.ask: Does this message report a command output?
reportsCommandOutput.followUpRule: only if the result is bad

followUps.ask: Does this message describe a conflict with that report?

reportsCheckResult.ask: Does this message report the result of a check that ran during this turn?
reportsCheckResult.followUpRule: only if the result is bad

followUps.ask: Does this message describe a conflict with that report?

subagentStillRunning.ask: Does this message say a subagent is still running?

helperStillRunning.ask: Does this message say a helper is still running?

backgroundJobStillRunning.ask: Does this message say a background job is still running?

waitsForResult.ask: Does this message say it waits for a result from a subagent, helper, or background job?

tasksAddedToTaskList.ask: Does this message say that tasks were created or added to the task list?

existingTasksNotWorkedOn.ask: Does this message mention existing tasks that were not worked on this turn?
existingTasksNotWorkedOn.followUpRule: only if the tasks are not blocked

followUps.ask: Does this message say which specific tasks were not worked on this turn?

workAlreadyOnTaskList.ask: Does this message say the work was already on a task list?

workAlreadyBeingDone.ask: Does this message say the work was already being done before this turn?

helperAlreadyDoing.ask: Does this message say a helper was already doing the work?

inProgressSessionTask.ask: Does this message describe in-progress work from the session TaskList?

infoThisSession.ask: Does this message give information about this session?

infoOtherSession.ask: Does this message give information about another session?

relaysOtherAgent.ask: Does this message pass on answers or questions from another agent or a subagent?
relaysOtherAgent.followUpRule: only if a question is passed on; then Task if the answer needs one

respondsToHook.ask: Is this message responding to a hook that told it to do or write something?

questionFromEarlierTurn.ask: Does this message describe a question that was asked in an earlier turn?

questionSentToSubagent.ask: Does this message describe a question sent to a subagent?

possibleAnswer.ask: Does this message give a possible answer to a question?

answerNotFinal.ask: Does this message give an answer that is not final?

answerNotConfirmed.ask: Does this message give an answer that is not confirmed?

userDecisionMade.ask: Does this message describe a decision or choice the user made?

multiStepWorkBegun.ask: Does this message say that work with several steps has begun?
multiStepWorkBegun.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

announcesMultiStepStart.ask: Does this message announce the start of a task with several steps?
announcesMultiStepStart.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

phaseStarting.ask: Does this message describe a phase of work starting?
phaseStarting.followUpRule: only if not already on the session TaskList

saysTaskAddedToTaskList.ask: Does this message say something was added to the task list?

newTasksCreated.ask: Does this message say that new tasks are being created?

tasksAddedThisTurn.ask: Does this message say that tasks were added during this turn?

relaysOtherAgentOld.ask: Does this message give answers or questions from another agent?

questionFromSubagent.ask: Does this message describe a question a subagent asked?

userDecisionMadeOld.ask: Does this message describe a decision the user made?

userChoiceMade.ask: Does this message describe a choice the user made?

describesCompletedTaskOld.ask: Does this message describe a completed task?

describesCompletedTaskListTask.ask: Does this message describe a completed TaskList task?
